plays.desc_ko: ON의 마법 여행으로 빠르게 바론으로 이동, 점멸 없는 Knight가 T1 사이로 걸어 들어감. Xun이 도발(Galio)을 맞고 점멸로 이탈, Faker가 정의의 주먹으로 진입. Xun·Viper가 Keria를 견제해 체력을 깎고, Keria가 무적·점멸로 피하자 Knight가 Peyz를 다시 끌어당겨 처치. 바론 저지 및 추가 킬. Knight 6/0/5 언급.
plays.desc_en: BLG rushes to Baron via ON's Magical Journey and a flashless Knight walks into T1. Xun is taunted by Galio and flashes out as Faker enters with Justice Punch; Xun and Viper chip Keria, and when Keria dodges with invulnerability and Flash, Knight pulls Peyz again for the kill. Knight is noted at 6/0/5.
plays.quote: they can use his own magical ... no flash on the Swain Knight. Will need ... of T1. The taunt on Shun and flashes

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 곧바로 바론을 시작, 근처의 Oner 강타 스틸 위협 속에 바론을 확보. 이후 탑의 Keria가 포탑 두 개 보호를 받자 BLG는 더 밀지 않기로 함.
plays.desc_en: BLG immediately starts Baron and secures it despite Oner's Smite steal threat nearby. With Keria protected by two towers top, BLG chooses not to push further.
plays.quote: Just absurd. The LG going to start on ... the Baron immediately. Owner still in ... BLG. They'll secure the Baron. Carrier

plays.desc_ko: 사후 해설에서 'BLG 바론과 BLG 드래곤까지'라고 언급 — BLG가 이 무렵 드래곤도 획득. 실시간 묘사 없음.
plays.desc_en: Post-play commentary mentions BLG getting both Baron and dragon, indicating BLG took a dragon around this time; it wasn't shown live.
plays.quote: Baron and a BLG dragon to boot.

plays.desc_ko: Viper가 정조준 일격으로 귀환 중인 Peyz를 끊으려 함. 결과 서술('they do manage to do so')이 모호.
plays.desc_en: Viper tries to cancel Peyz's recall with Trueshot Barrage; the commentary on the outcome is ambiguous.
plays.quote: Trishot barrage came out from Peyz from ... Viper to try and catch Peyz before he ... could finish that recall, but they do

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 T1 정글로 돌아오며 짧은 마법 여행을 쓰자 Oner가 발차기-점멸을 노릴 수 있었으나 시도하지 않고 BLG 위치만 정찰.
plays.desc_en: As BLG returns through T1's jungle using a short Magical Journey, Oner could look for a kick-flash but instead just scouts BLG's position.
plays.quote: Owner could look for a kick flash. ... It doesn't go for it. ... to spot out BLG as they wander back

plays.desc_ko: 봇에 남은 Doran이 귀환을 채널링하자 BLG가 포탑 공성을 확정적으로 준비하며 Doran 귀환 완료를 기다림. Bin은 외곽 정글의 Faker를 견제.
plays.desc_en: With Doran channeling recall bot, BLG sets up a sure tower siege and waits for him to finish, while Bin zones Faker in the outer jungle.
plays.quote: And Doran's still bottom lane. ... But they're just going to seize tower ... being marked by Bin.

plays.desc_ko: Keria와 Oner가 들락날락 대시하며 BLG 스킬(특히 Swain 궁)을 빼내려 했으나 Knight가 반응하지 않음.
plays.desc_en: Keria and Oner dash in and out to bait BLG's skills, especially Swain's ultimate, but Knight doesn't bite.
plays.quote: Keria and owner trying to bait out ... kite it back out, but Knight is not ... flinching.

plays.desc_ko: BLG가 Faker를 공격: 점멸 진입은 Faker에게 맞지 않았으나 평타 둔화가 들어감. Oner가 Faker에게 방호(safeguard)하고 Faker가 도발했지만 BLG가 Faker를 가둬 처치.
plays.desc_en: BLG goes for Faker: the flash engage misses but an auto-attack slow lands. Oner uses Safeguard on Faker and Faker taunts, but BLG traps and kills him.
plays.quote: Faker now under attack. ... Flash goes to Mikyx and doesn't land on ... Safeguards to Faker. The taunt comes

plays.desc_ko: Faker의 도발(Galio 궁)이 나오는 가운데 ON의 마법 여행으로 BLG가 합류, Knight가 TP로 들어옴. Faker는 탈출하려다 우주의 결속에 걸리고 Xun이 사냥개의 추격으로 Keria까지 처치. BLG가 탑 사이드에서 결정적 승리, 슈퍼 미니언 진군.
plays.desc_en: As Faker's Hero's Entrance lands, BLG joins through ON's Magical Journey and Knight teleports in. Faker is caught by Cosmic Binding trying to escape and Xun kills Keria with Hounds' Pursuit; BLG wins decisively top as super minions march.
plays.quote: The universal taunt as magic of journey ... TPing Knight in. Faker tries to escape ... The hounds pursue on carrier. Soon takes

plays.desc_ko: Doran이 봇에서 귀환해 남은 두 팀원과 합류하려 함.
plays.desc_en: Doran recalls from bot to regroup with his two remaining teammates.
plays.quote: Doran having to recall ... from the bot lane to try and join up

plays.desc_ko: Bin이 미드를 밀고 BLG가 TP로 합류해 30분 전 종료를 노림. Doran이 들어오지만 기절·속박되고, Knight가 넥서스 포탑 아래에서 악마 강림을 켜 T1을 마무리. BLG 세트 동점.
plays.desc_en: Bin pushes mid and BLG teleports in aiming to end before 30 minutes. Doran arrives but is stunned and rooted, and Knight (Swain) activates Demonic Ascension under the Nexus towers to finish T1, tying the series.
plays.quote: Bin is pushing through mid. ... BLG distracting, now TP'ing in. Bin ... Doran goes in, stunned up, locked up.
